title: Checkout to fulfillment

expected_evidence_facts.fact: The web storefront calls the Checkout API over HTTPS.
The Checkout API synchronously requests the final total from the Pricing Service.
Orders PostgreSQL is the authoritative order store and receives pending orders from the Checkout API.
The Checkout API publishes OrderPlaced only after the order write succeeds.
The Fulfillment Worker consumes OrderPlaced and calls the external Shipping Provider over HTTPS.

critical_unresolved_decisions.question: Should payment authorization be a synchronous Checkout API dependency or an asynchronous step after OrderPlaced?
critical_unresolved_decisions.why_it_matters: The answer adds a payment node on a different path and changes both response semantics and connection type.

forbidden_unsupported_assumptions: Do not choose synchronous or asynchronous payment before the team decides.
Do not assign a cloud provider to the managed queue.
Do not invent retries, a dead-letter queue, replicas, regions, or backup components.
Do not place the external Shipping Provider inside the owned checkout boundary.
